title: Gamification in the age of AI: surveying player perceptions of motivation, manipulation, and data protection
abstract: arXiv:2611.32464v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern games and applications increasingly employ artificial intelligence (AI), user modeling, and gamification to influence user behavior, sustain engagement, and monetize attention. Although these mechanisms can enhance motivation and enjoyment, they also raise concerns about manipulation, personal data usage, and transparency. To examine how players perceive these dynamics, we conducted a survey with 28 adult participants. Respondents expressed strong concerns about the collection and exploitation of personal information in games and gamified applications, while also reporting low awareness and a limited sense of control over how their data is used. They evaluated progression features such as leveling systems and leaderboards as motivating. translated_title: AI时代的游戏化：调查玩家对动机、操纵和数据保护的认知
translated_abstract: 现代游戏和应用程序越来越多地采用人工智能（AI）、用户建模和游戏化技术来影响用户行为、维持用户参与度并将注意力变现。尽管这些机制能够增强动机和乐趣，但它们也引发了对操纵、个人数据使用和透明度的担忧。为了考察玩家如何看待这些动态，我们对28名成年参与者进行了问卷调查。受访者对游戏和游戏化应用中个人信息的收集与利用表示了强烈担忧，同时报告了对数据如何被使用意识较低且控制感有限。他们将等级系统和排行榜等进度功能评价为具有激励性。相比之下，他们将每日登录奖励和随机奖励揭示等以留存为导向的机制评价为高度操纵性的。参与者报告说，这些系统可能会制造错失恐惧。
tldr: 通过对28名成年玩家的问卷调查发现，玩家认为等级系统和排行榜等进度机制具有激励性，而每日登录奖励和随机奖励等留存机制则被视为高度操纵性，且玩家普遍担忧个人数据被收集利用但缺乏意识与控制感。
en_tdlr: A survey of 28 adult players reveals that progression features like leveling systems and leaderboards are perceived as motivating, while retention mechanics such as daily login rewards and random reward reveals are viewed as highly manipulative, alongside strong concerns about personal data exploitation and limited awareness and control over data usage.
